editorial.blurb: Valois is a beloved Chicago institution near UChicago where efficient counter service and generous portions of classic breakfast fare have made it a neighborhood staple for decades.
editorial.insiderTip: Order at the counter, grab your plate from the kitchen staff, then find your own seat—turnover is quick even when busy. Ask for cornbread instead of toast, bring cash, and don't miss the Louisiana hot sauce on every table.
